acc.name: ACC
acc.notes: Steps match; unequal-schedule tied-team chain (policy 1.a-b, 2.a; On3/Strickland) not modeled: probe/acc3.js shows engine cannot return the team the chain reaches. Do not claim out/clinched when an 8-game team (BC, Clemson, FSU, Georgia Tech, UNC) can be in the tied group. Ineligible teams not removed.

mwest.name: Mountain West
mwest.notes: Order of steps matches. Encoding differs after the CFP/composite step: step 4 pool is 'not included in the original standings tie'; steps 3-5 continue (restart only at step 1 and at two teams for one spot); ineligible teams removed first (not modeled). Mismatches are masked because the CFP/composite step branches over all tied teams. Flip only for calls that hold under every ranking outcome.

belt.name: Sun Belt
belt.revision: Live page, URL dated 2018, footer 2026; no revision stamp
belt.notes: All steps match. Page still lists Texas State (West) and no Louisiana Tech; 2026 divisions taken from official 2026 schedule release and standings. Ineligible-champion rule not modeled. Flip for outcomes settled before the CFP/computer step.

pac12.name: Pac-12
pac12.notes: All steps and orders match. Tie-for-second reading (head-to-head first or not) is ambiguous and carried as two readings by the engine. Text silent on teams dropped from a 3+ tie (engine continues down the list).

usa.name: Conference USA
usa.revision: File last modified Nov 16, 2025; no 2026-dated version
usa.notes: Encoding matches this PDF step for step. Secondary sources (PFSN Nov 10, 2025; July 2025 forum post) show a different order (CFP-ranked, APR). Not confirmed which is current. 3+ team head-to-head wording is thin (two readings carried). Flip only for win-percentage or head-to-head calls.

midam.name: MAC
midam.notes: Full step match. Text silent on what happens to remaining teams after one advances in a 3+ tie (engine restarts). No 2026 revision found.

big10.name: Big Ten
big10.revision: 2024 Big Ten Football Championship Game Tiebreaker, Aug 23, 2024 PDF (copy from earlier agent)
big10.notes: Steps match the 2024 text. Official URL is 404 and no 2026 republication found, so 2026 applicability is inferred. Section B names ties for first only. Sanctions-ineligible rule not modeled. Low risk.

American.name: American
American.notes: Full step match, including host list. 10.6.1 'ranking' wording makes restart vs continue unspecified for 4+ team ties. Exempt games and ineligible rule (10.7) not modeled.

big12.name: Big 12
big12.notes: Full match; no 2026 change found. Silent on teams dropped from a 3+ tie for second (engine continues). 12-game wins step needs all non-conference games played.

sec.name: SEC
sec.revision: PDF dated Oct 29, 2024; no 2026 change found
sec.notes: Order and restart semantics match; sub-branches of the 22 pages not each tested against the engine. Step E capped scoring margin (Appendix A) treated as external.
